about.text: Cheddar cheese is a natural cheese that is relatively hard, off-white, and sometimes sharp-tasting. It originates from the village of Cheddar in Somerset, South West England.

how.text: Turning and stacking the curd slabs by hand (cheddaring) comes before milling, salting and mechanical pressing. At least nine months of natural maturing gives a nutty, full, rounded flavour with a hint of sharpness.
